'''Tree turtles''' were a type of [[Turtle/Legends|turtle]] native to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] that was home to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
